newsitem.title: NORWAY: Statoil drills multi-purpose Statfjord North well.
newsitem.headline: Statoil drills multi-purpose Statfjord North well.

text.p: Den norske stats oljeselskap AS (Statoil) said on Thursday it was drilling a combined exploration and production well on the Statfjord North satellite in the North Sea.
After passing horizontally through two producing zones, well 33/9-E-4H will drop almost vertically to test the Y prospect south of the field, the company's Status Weekly newsletter said.
The Y prospect could contain close to 100 million barrels, although the likelihood of making a find was put at 25 percent, it said.

"Statoil is combining exploration and production in one well because this approach has proved a cost-effective way of establishing additional reserves. Any finds can be brought on stream immediately," the company said.
